Subject: SOC 2 packet and next steps

Hi Ethan — great to chat earlier today. Thanks for walking through FintechCo's integration needs. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Recap: You’re running a customer-facing payments product and want predictable inference latency (90th p99 target) and strong controls around data retention and access.
- What I sent: attached is our SOC 2 packet (FintechCo_SOC2_packet_v1.pdf) and a network diagram that Operations/InfoSec often asks for.
- Ask from your side: can you confirm who on your InfoSec/procurement team should receive the packet and what timeline you’re targeting for review?
- Proposed next steps:
  - I can jump on a short call with your InfoSec if helpful (15-30 minutes).
  - If there are specific questions around KMS/HSM, encryption at rest/in-transit, or audit log retention, flag them and I’ll get answers from our security team.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll follow up early next week to check timing. Thanks again — excited about the potential to move forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: FintechCo_SOC2_packet_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 2.8MB), network_diagram.png (image/png, 420KB)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the packet.

Quick answers:
- I’ve forwarded the packet to our InfoSec mailbox (security@fintechco.com) and legal/procurement.
- Targeting an initial review by next Friday (2027-03-05); InfoSec will escalate any blockers.

One question up front: can you include a short note confirming whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest (we prefer keys we control)? If that’s not supported, can you state the default key management approach?

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute sync between our InfoSec and your security lead next week.

Thanks,
Ethan
